title: Las dificultades de la transición
goal: Read how Guatemala's failed 1993 "serranazo" self-coup showed the region's changed response to such attempts, plus the institutional and economic constraints young democracies inherited from the dictatorships and the debt crisis.

items: State what Serrano did on May 25, 1993.
